items.title: I asked Derrick White about how having Jordan Walsh in the starting lineup, guarding Cade Cunningham, made life easier for him:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
I asked Derrick White about how having Jordan Walsh in the starting lineup, guarding Cade Cunningham, made life easier for him:

“Jordan is a hell of a defender, and just going out there picking up Cade and making him work.

“Just all those little body punches kind of helped through the whole game.”

items.title: Derrick White noted Paul George’s impact at both ends of the floor while discussing his Celtics debut:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Derrick White noted Paul George’s impact at both ends of the floor while discussing his Celtics debut:

“It was fun to watch. Obviously, got super hot, and try to find him in different ways.”

quote.author: Bobby Krivitsky
quote.text:
Paul George said this was a “rough training camp for him,” figuring out new concepts, terms, plays, & teammates.

Yet Celtics praised him for confidence he played with.

Asked George about going from feeling that way in camp to playing the way he did today.

“I feel like I'm getting my pop back.”

“The game is connected…Any time you have live-ball turnovers or you get stagnant on one end, it gets the crowd going, it gets them going, and that was a big thing on their run.”
